text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Хиши Амадзон! She
takes the
win, staying true to her
promise!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

Хиши Амадзон was awesome! I wonder
where we'll
see her next?
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
I hope she'll turn up at the Japan Cup or
the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
And if Нарита Брайан makes an
appearance, we can
count on a great
race.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Yeeeah! Did you see that, Teach?! I won!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I won first place, just like I
promised. This
victory should help build
up my reputation a bit
more, eh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The only race left is my one-on-one at
the Arima
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон looks like she has
something on her
mind.

I've been thinking... Before we take on
the Arima
Kinen, could we have a go at
another big race
first?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I only ran the Osaka Hai and the Yasuda
Kinen in
order to prep for the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The idea was for me to beef up in time
for the big
race, right?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: But you know what? I had so much fun out there!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The competition was super intense! It
was
electrifying!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I feel like another tough battle like that would make me even stronger, and...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Why am I beating around the bush?
What I'm
trying to say is—I want to run
in the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I want to experience another real excitin'

one-on-one!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон is already buzzing with
excitement
just thinking about the
thrilling battle ahead.
And I see no reason to slow her roll.
choice_data_list: Of course you can run it!

text_block_list.text:
We set our sights on the Japan Cup,
where only
the best of the best gather
to race!
